title: Product Trainer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a  Soft Skills & Product Trainer  to train and develop call center agents in communication, customer service, and product knowledge. The role involves onboarding new employees, conducting refresher training, identifying skill gaps, and supporting overall team performance. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct induction and product training for new hires. Deliver soft skills training on communication, customer service, and call handling. Organize refresher sessions and coaching based on quality and performance feedback. Develop and update training materials, presentations, and assessments. Work closely with Operations and Quality teams to address training needs. Evaluate trainee performance through assessments and maintain training records. Track training effectiveness and prepare basic training reports. 
 Required Skills Strong communication and presentation skills. Good knowledge of customer service and call handling techniques. Understanding of call center KPIs such as AHT, CSAT, FCR, and QA scores. Ability to conduct engaging training sessions. Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, Excel, and training content preparation. 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. 2 to 5 years of experience in a call center, including at least 1 year in a training role. Experience in product/process training and soft skills coaching. Prior experience in a BPO/KPO environment is preferred. Certification in Training & Development or Soft Skills Coaching is an added advantage.

Key Skills: Process Training,Service Training,Customer Service Training,Product Training,Customer service,Training,Process

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Content Writer to develop and analyze digital content that supports key business objectives at GEODIS. The successful candidate should have a strong background in technical writing, content management, and eLearning development. Job Duties Primary Duties Develop digital content, including training materials, user guides, and help documentation for GEODIS' logistics and supply chain management services. Analyze existing content, identify gaps, and make recommendations for improvement. Design and develop eLearning materials, including storyboards, on-screen texts, and audio scripts. Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) across GEODIS' business functions to develop high-quality content. Conduct analytics to measure the effectiveness of digital content and make data-driven recommendations. Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including product managers, business analysts, and business SMEs. Work independently and as part of a team to deliver high-quality content within defined timelines. Other Duties As required and assigned. Minimum Requirements Experience/Educational Qualifications 2-4 years of experience in technical writing, content management, and eLearning development. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. Ability to communicate and build positive relationships with stakeholders. Experience working with product managers, business analysts, and business SMEs. Hands-on experience delivering eLearning material on technology products. High level of motivation, self-starter, excellent at follow-up, and team-player. Experience with content management systems and eLearning authoring tools. Knowledge of instructional design methodologies. Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Familiarity with logistics and supply chain management services. Essential Skills Ability to adapt to changing business requirements and communicate changes to stakeholders. Experience with CMS (Content Management Systems) tools. Basic understanding of Analytics tools. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. High attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work products.

Key Skills: Instructional Design,Elearning Development,CMS,Technical Writing,Stakeholder Management,Logistics and Supply Chain,Storyboarding,Content Analytics

title: Content Creator
description:
Content Creator Industry: EdTech / Education Technology
 Department: Marketing & Content
 Location: Kochi, Kerala
 Experience: 13 Years 
 Job Summary We are looking for a creative and energetic Content Creator to develop engaging digital content for our EdTech brand. The candidate will be responsible for creating Reels, short-form videos, social media creatives, educational content, and promotional videos that effectively communicate our courses, training programs, student success stories, and brand message. Key Responsibilities Create engaging Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, promotional videos, and social media content . Plan, shoot, edit, and publish short-form video content. Develop creative content around education, technology, career opportunities, courses, and student experiences . Handle basic videography, lighting, framing, and audio recording . Edit videos using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software . Create social media creatives using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools . Develop scripts, captions, hooks, and creative concepts for videos. Follow current social media trends, formats, sounds, and content styles . Collaborate with the marketing and academic teams to develop content ideas. Create content for multiple platforms including Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms . Optimize content for audience engagement, reach, views, and conversions . Support the execution of social media campaigns and promotional activities. Maintain a regular content calendar and ensure timely delivery of assigned content. Analyze content performance and suggest improvements based on engagement and audience response. Required Skills Strong content creation and storytelling skills . Good knowledge of short-form video creation and editing . Basic knowledge of videography and cinematography . Proficiency in at least one professional video editing software . Knowledge of Canva / Photoshop is an added advantage. Good understanding of Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn . Ability to write engaging scripts, captions, and social media copy . Awareness of current social media trends. Good communication and presentation skills. Creative mindset with the ability to generate new content ideas. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree/diploma in Mass Communication, Visual Communication, Media, Digital Marketing, Multimedia, or a related field . Candidates with a strong portfolio of Reels, videos, or social media content will be preferred. Experience in the EdTech, education, training, or digital marketing industry is an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number and quality of content pieces produced. Video views and audience retention. Engagement rate and social media reach. Lead generation through content. Content consistency and timely delivery. Growth in social media followers and brand visibility. What We Offer Opportunity to work in a growing EdTech environment . Hands-on exposure to education and technology-focused content. Creative freedom to experiment with new content formats. Opportunity to work with marketing, academic, and business teams.

Key Skills: Content Creation,Creative,Brand Building,Creative Writing,Videography,Content,Video,Facebook
